author: RIM team
description: Lists the open pull requests of the GitHub repositories you choose. Talks only to GitHub, with your own token if you add one in its settings.

commands.title: Pull requests: Refresh
commands.description: Fetches the open pull requests again.

commands.title: Pull requests: Add repository
commands.description: Adds a GitHub repository to the list, at most 10.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.description: The repository as owner/name, such as rust-lang/rust.

commands.title: Pull requests: Remove repository
commands.description: Removes a repository from the list.

panels.title: Pull requests
panels.description: Open pull requests of the repositories on your list.

settings_schema.title: GitHub token
settings_schema.description: Optional, desktop app only. A fine-grained personal access token with Public repositories (read-only) access and an expiry date raises GitHub's limit from 60 to 5,000 requests an hour. Kept in this device's encrypted secret vault, never synced, sent only to api.github.com.
